text:
mike: quick brain-dump: proposing a 'tiered-spline' rollout guard that 1) runs SPRT-style early stopping on fidelity + hallucination, 2) watches p95/p99 latency drift for tail meltdown, and 3) enforces per-cohort hard limits (billing/legal=hard). If SPRT accepts alt (bad) hypothesis -> soft-fallback to quant-sibling; if latency tail spikes > 30% -> immediate circuit-breaker rollback. thoughts?

sara: nice framing. SPRT could cut noisy promos early. want to see false-positive rate targets and max sample budget.

kevin: sketch config idea:```yaml
rollout_guard:
  name: tiered_spline_v1
  sample_budget: 5000
  sprt:
    alpha: 0.01  # false positive
    beta: 0.1    # false negative
    metric: fidelity_delta
    alt_threshold: 0.04
  metrics:
    - name: token_halluc_rate
      action: soft_fallback
      fallback_variant: v2q-lite
      threshold: 0.02
    - name: p99_latency_increase
      action: rollback
      threshold: 0.30
  cohorts:
    hard_limits: [billing, contracts, pii]
    weights: {billing: 3.0, contracts: 2.0}
  cooldown_seconds: 1200
  lease_fraction: 0.03
```

li: prefer using sequential monte-carlo bounds for nonparametric metrics (esp. hallucination). for SPRT, we'll need estimated likelihood ratio; i can proto with Beta-binomial for token_halluc stats.

annie: include a "grace-route" option: when soft_fallback triggers, route 2% of affected traffic to the cheap sibling and keep 1% to original for further diagnostic logs. helps debugging without full rollback.

ml-eval-bot: eval report for candidate v3q1: fidelity_delta=0.045, token_halluc_rate=0.018, p99_latency_increase=0.12, sprt_status=continue, samples=1200. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/ml-evals/1768139999/v3q1

mike: eval bot indicates fidelity slightly above alt_threshold, but SPRT still needs more samples. token halluc below soft threshold. i'd hold promo until SPRT finishes or samples reach sample_budget.

kevin: ops runbook draft idea: if SPRT stops in favor of alt (bad), enact soft_fallback for 30m + notify #oncall + collect debug snapshots. if p99 spike causes rollback, trigger 15m incident and auto-block promotes for 2h.

infra-bot: canary rollout started: 5% -> 10% step queued (deploy 1768140100).

li: note on math: with alpha=0.01 and beta=0.1, expected avg sample maybe ~2000 depending on true delta. i'll attach quick sim later. also recommend tracking cumulative log-likelihood for drift detection.

annie: add allowlist for debug logging: `debug_cohorts: [contracts]` so we keep long traces for those slices.

kevin: tiny pseudo for SPRT stop check:```python
from math import log
LR = lambda p0,p1,k,n: k*log(p1/p0) + (n-k)*log((1-p1)/(1-p0))
if LR(p0,p1,k,n) > log((1-beta)/alpha): reject_null()
```

mike: action items: li -> sim for SPRT params, kevin -> implement grace-route + fallback wiring, annie -> produce cohort allow/block lists, sara -> sign off on sample_budget and cooldown defaults. i'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow. :calendar:
